Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the date format and incorrectly converted “10/06/1819” to October 6, 1819 (1819-10-06). All reliable sources (Britannica and Wikipedia) indicate June 10, 1819; the error arose from confusing day/month with month/day during normalization.
